kind: Static disassembly audit and llvm-mca model, not measured hardware counters
model_resources: SPRPort00..11: selected Granite model reuses SPR scheduling resources
extraction: Complete timed independent-hit loop, all four lanes, active>0, query loop continuing.
Start immediately after query-end jbe, trace instructions until returning there; candidate-loop jne repeats until1/2/4th candidate succeeds in every lane.
Candidate-empty/active-zero je paths excluded; active-nonzero jne and unconditional jumps followed.
Actual operand/register/stack instructions preserved; branch targets replaced by one assembler label because llvm-mca evaluates a linear instruction stream.
MCA repeats each traced four-query path100times. Disassembly addresses and exact symbol identity remain in mca.json.
limitations: No branch predictor, instruction-cache placement, real cache misses, split-load penalties, or measured core frequency.
Both independent-memory and conservative-all-may-alias models retained; neither describes precise real stack forwarding.
Simulated cycles are model outputs and must not be compared as absolute native timings.
The modeled backend paths generally favor composed and fail to reproduce the measured35% hit loss.
64B code-line crossing counts alone also fail: composed10B has1 crossing candidate loop, raw10B has2.
Allocation addresses were not recorded in the original timed campaign; geometry is enumerated for16B-aligned base phases, not asserted as measured.
next_experiment: One Granite AVX2 four-way composed/raw32/64-bit candidate-mask crossover; all other source/layout/query/workload dimensions fixed. No stride or other-platform expansion.
